scope: Exploratory moving-card experiment; not road detection validation

method.metric: median apparent dark-line FWHM in reference pixels
method.registration: affine; confidence/pose filtering; each adjacent sensor gap <=50ms
method.uncertainty_note: Adjacent frames are correlated. Counts are not independent repeats; no significance or confidence claim.
method.data_availability: Aggregates and target-only footage public. Full indoor captures are not distributed.

resources.scope: Isolated CPU excludes capture, ISP, HTTP, JPEG/video encoding. Whole-demo RSS is not algorithm-only. Short measurements, not stress tests.

limitations: One sequential trial per mode; no controlled repeatability or road tests
Hand motion and illumination/pose may vary
Tracking rejected different fractions of the recordings
Fixed 4ms had narrower moving lines than adaptive in this experiment
Adaptive benefit at rest is observed restoration of native exposure, not proven detection/SNR superiority
No neural detector, trash recall or 1-3cm road-object validation
Readback latency and acceleration can violate the heuristic blur budget
